review.description: S4/S5 retain the shared fixture qualification contract while hosted checkout now provides complete history before measuring Playwright. Contributor documentation describes local PR-base Git metadata collection; stable IDs, initial-adoption policy and all existing limitations remain unchanged.
review.implementation: Compared c347d49 and candidate workflow: existing Make preparation, repository-root qualifier, fifteen exact triggers, dispatch, fixture0, exact-head ref, disabled persisted credentials, job identity and always-upload seven-day diagnostics remain. Added only fetch-depth0 to checkout; pinned actions/checkout action.yml defines this as all history, and installed locked Playwright1.64.1 gitDiff fetches the event base only when cat-file cannot find it. The current event base c347d49 is an ancestor of the selected PR head, so complete history removes the observed optional fetch during measurement. Strict raw stdout/JSON, metrics, Git metadata capture, topology and retries are unchanged.
review.tests: Read and ran HostedCITests.test_browser_benchmark_retains_samples_and_stops_on_failure: new assertion requires checkout fetch-depth0 alongside exact ref and persist-credentials false; existing configured-command fixture still executes exits0/19, verifies exact output arguments and retains summary/discovery diagnostics. Read unchanged qualifier main failure/inventory tests and direct strict json.loads path; malformed raw output remains rejected. Reviewed both inherited dispatcher tests: bounded push/PR/manual/bootstrap success/exit23 preserve comparison/source/fixture0, interrupted version collection preserves selected plan/root phases and starts no worker. Read native keep-going/shared-once and pipe/FIFO assertions; their implementations and mappings remain unchanged. Mandatory reconciliation and make ci will execute the retained full suites.
